user.title: Set up Powertech Gate
user.description: Choose the recommended Powertech account setup, or use the manual AWS certificate setup.

account.title: Powertech account
account.description: Sign in with your Powertech/EyeOpen account. Your password is used only during setup and is not stored. The integration discovers Powertech gate devices with a UUID and AWS IoT endpoint and applies known model capabilities automatically.

device.title: Select gate
device.description: Select the Powertech IoT device you want to add.

manual.title: Manual AWS certificate setup
manual.description: Advanced fallback for an existing AWS IoT certificate/private key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Powertech account
reconfigure.description: Sign in again to regenerate the AWS IoT certificate for this gate. Your password is not stored.

pin.title: Verify gate PIN
pin.description: Enter the gate's six-digit PIN. It is verified against the current WBT shadow in the same way as EyeOpen and is not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Powertech backend.
error.no_devices: No compatible Powertech/EyeOpen AWS IoT gate device was found.
error.file_not_found: One or more certificate files were not found.
error.invalid_certificate: The certificate/private key/CA could not be loaded.
error.device_not_in_account: The configured gate is not present in this Powertech account.
error.invalid_pin: The entered PIN does not match the gate PIN.
error.invalid_pin_format: The gate PIN must contain exactly six digits.

abort.already_configured: This Powertech device is already configured.
abort.account_session_lost: The temporary Powertech login session was lost. Start setup again.
abort.certificate_failed: Powertech did not return a usable AWS IoT certificate.
abort.policy_failed: The AWS IoT certificate policy could not be attached to the selected device.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not complete provisioning because the Powertech backend could not be reached.
abort.unsupported_protocol: The device has an AWS IoT endpoint, but the required Powertech gate DEV INFO / DEV STATUS shadow fields were not received. Gate control was not enabled for safety.
